- Independent subagent migration_plan_review verified correction revision 594 against submitted target 590; the constraint/invalidation finding is resolved in the plan.
- One pure predicate model reads tracked engine data; external changes enter validated transactions. Existing and new edges are checked against candidate state, with no state/cache/event changes after rejection.
- Required proof now covers missing/enumerated reads, branch cleanup and disposal; predicate purity is correctly a test/review obligation, not a TypeScript guarantee. Actual runtime, stored and transported components replace both graph node types and semantic kind classification.
- Accept the amended high-level plan. Compiler, runtime, performance and data-preservation results remain to be established by the implementation reviews; no human outcome is recorded.
